track.legalName: Petition for Expungement of Cannabis Charges and Convictions
track.publicName: Expungement of a cannabis charge or conviction
track.mechanism: Cannabis possession under Criminal Law § 5-601 where the conduct is no longer a crime expunges with no waiting period; possession is filed after satisfactory completion of the sentence; possession with intent to distribute under § 5-602 is filed three years after completion of the sentence. Section 10-107(a) carves cannabis possession out of the ordinary unit rule.
exclusions: Where other offences from the same incident are ineligible, the unit interaction under § 10-107(a) must be worked through carefully.

waitingPeriods.condition: Possession of a controlled dangerous substance (marijuana) under § 5-601 where the conduct is no longer a crime

waitingPeriods.duration: Filed after satisfactory completion of the sentence including probation, § 10-105(c)(8). No further wait.

waitingPeriods.condition: Possession with intent to distribute cannabis under § 5-602
waitingPeriods.duration: 3 years after completion of the sentence
